i.norm: Verifies that ofTaiSeconds normalizes negative nano adjustments by borrowing from the seconds field, and that adding Duration.ZERO returns the exact same instance. ofTaiSeconds(-10, -10ns): floorDiv(-10, 1_000_000_000) = -1 → seconds = -10 + (-1) = -11 floorMod(-10, 1_000_000_000) = 999_999_990 → nanos = 999_999_990
Create an instant with a negative nano adjustment; the factory normalizes it so that nanos stay in [0, 999_999_999] by borrowing one second.
Adding zero duration must return the exact same instance (identity shortcut)
Borrowing 1s from -10s gives -11s, and -10ns mod 1_000_000_000 gives 999_999_990ns
